theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+2.13%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.73%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-0.53%) and Real Estate (-0.17%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.62% versus +0.13% for defensives and +0.30% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.35% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.03%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.96%. The VIX fell 11.51% to 24.91, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.56% to $4,076.70, crude oil was little changed at $90.00, and bitcoin slipped 0.25% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
